description: A local-first adaptive file workbench that detects an uploaded file and offers relevant transforms, compression, extraction, cleanup and delivery presets.
target_user: Creators and small teams who need fast, trustworthy preparation of images, video, audio and PDFs.
primary_problem: File conversion and preparation are fragmented across many single-purpose utilities and destructive cloud upload flows.
release_readiness: Not assessed; no prototype or demand validation yet.
major_missing_features: Local-processing architecture and browser capability matrix
competitive_position: Unassessed. Potential differentiation: one adaptive local-first workspace rather than many one-off converters.
strategic_value: Potential acquisition surface and companion workflow; hypothesis pending validation.
next_milestone: Validate the focused MVP, demand, local-processing feasibility and truthful capability boundary before prototyping.
evidence_sources: Armon, Discord #thecreativeco, 2026-10-09: FileLab adaptive upload-and-operation concept
evidence_freshness: Founder concept; market, implementation and user validation absent.
execution_hold: Do not build or publish before the validation task has evidence and an explicit CONTINUE/PIVOT/KILL decision.
